name: supply_chain_list_stock_replenishment_risk_items
description:
Identify inventory items at risk of stockout or insufficient days-of-supply.

IMPORTANT — flat input: pass all parameters at top level. Do NOT use nested query/filters/tool_specific wrappers.

Required: company_id (integer). Calls without company_id are rejected by schema.

Use cases:
- Surface items approaching or at stockout risk
- Identify products with insufficient days-of-supply buffer
- Understand inbound supply timing and p80 arrival dates
- Prioritize replenishment orders or expedited actions

Risk dimensions (two independent analyses):
1. Stockout Risk — will physical inventory run out?
   high: days_of_supply(p50) < 0 | moderate: p50≥0 but p80<0 | low: p80≥0 but p95<0 | ok: p95≥0
2. Supply Buffer Risk — is buffer below min_days_of_supply target?
   high: p50 < threshold | moderate: p50≥threshold but p80<threshold | low: p80≥threshold but p95<threshold | ok: p95≥threshold

Velocity preset modes: balanced (0.5/0.3/0.2), conservative (0.7/0.2/0.1), aggressive (0.2/0.3/0.5)

company_id.description: REQUIRED. Company ID (integer). Calls without this field are rejected by schema.

revenue_abcd_class.description: Filter by revenue class (A=top 20%, B=next 30%, C=next 30%, D=tail 20%).

sort.description: Sort by any output field. Default: stockout_risk_tier asc.

select_fields.description: Optional output field projection. Omit to return all default fields.

min_days_of_supply.description: Target days-of-supply buffer. Items below this threshold are flagged as supply_buffer_risk.

velocity_weighting_mode.description: Velocity preset. balanced=(0.5/0.3/0.2), conservative=(0.7/0.2/0.1), aggressive=(0.2/0.3/0.5). Default: balanced.

velocity_weighting.description: Custom velocity weights (overridden by velocity_weighting_mode if both provided).

include_warehouse_stock.description: Include non-FBA warehouse/3PL stock in available supply. Default: true.

include_inbound_details.description: Include FBA inbound shipment details (count, units, arrival dates). Default: true.

p80_arrival_buffer_days.description: Safety buffer subtracted from p80 inbound arrival estimates (accounts for receiving delays).

stockout_risk_filter.description: Return only items matching these stockout risk tiers (OR logic). Omit to include all tiers.

supply_buffer_risk_filter.description: Return only items matching these supply buffer risk tiers (OR logic). Omit to include all tiers.

pareto_abc_class.description: Pareto ABC class from inventory snapshot.

current_fba_stock.description: Current available units in FBA inventory.

warehouse_stock.description: Current units in non-FBA warehouses/3PL (if include_warehouse_stock=true).

inbound_shipments_json.description: Raw FBA inbound shipments JSON from snapshot.

warehouse_balance_details_json.description: Raw warehouse balance details JSON from snapshot.

sales_velocity_30d.description: Avg daily sales rate (units/day) over last 30 days.

sales_velocity_7d.description: Avg daily sales rate over last 7 days.

sales_velocity_3d.description: Avg daily sales rate over last 3 days.

inbound_units.description: Total units in FBA inbound shipments.

inbound_p50_days.description: p50 likelihood (days) for inbound shipments to arrive (after p80_arrival_buffer_days applied).

inbound_p80_days.description: p80 likelihood (days) for inbound shipments to arrive (after p80_arrival_buffer_days applied).

inbound_p95_days.description: p95 likelihood (days) for inbound shipments to arrive (after p80_arrival_buffer_days applied).

days_of_supply_p50.description: Days-of-supply if inbound arrives at p50 (median) likelihood.

days_of_supply_p80.description: Days-of-supply if inbound arrives at p80 likelihood.

days_of_supply_p95.description: Days-of-supply if inbound arrives at p95 likelihood (optimistic).

stockout_risk_tier.description: Physical stockout risk classification based on p50/p80/p95 scenarios.

supply_buffer_risk_tier.description: Days-of-supply buffer risk classification (vs min_days_of_supply threshold) based on p50/p80/p95 scenarios.

stockout_critical_velocity.description: Velocity thresholds (units/day) at which stockout occurs for each scenario. Useful for understanding velocity sensitivity.

p50_units_per_day.description: Velocity (units/day) at which you stockout at p50 arrival.

p80_units_per_day.description: Velocity (units/day) at which you stockout at p80 arrival.

p95_units_per_day.description: Velocity (units/day) at which you stockout at p95 arrival.

supply_buffer_critical_velocity.description: Velocity thresholds (units/day) at which you fall below min_days_of_supply for each scenario. Guides replenishment targets.

p50_units_per_day.description: Velocity (units/day) at which supply drops below min threshold at p50 arrival.

p80_units_per_day.description: Velocity (units/day) at which supply drops below min threshold at p80 arrival.

p95_units_per_day.description: Velocity (units/day) at which supply drops below min threshold at p95 arrival.

po_recommended.description: True when a PO is recommended based on risk tiers.

po_recommendation_note.description: Next-step guidance to review PO placement candidates.

recommendation.description: Actionable suggestion based on both risk tiers, inbound timing, velocity trends, and risk severity (e.g., 'Urgent: expedite 500 units (p50 arrival in 12d, buffer critical)', 'Monitor velocity spike: p80 arrival covers 22d vs 28d target', 'Order 300 units (p95 scenario tight)').

risk_distribution.description: Counts by risk tier for both dimensions. Example: {stockout_risk: {high: 2, moderate: 5, low: 12, ok: 1043}, supply_buffer_risk: {high: 8, moderate: 15, low: 20, ok: 1019}}

examples.description: List high-risk stockout items for company 42
Supply buffer below 28d target, sort by days_of_supply_p80 ascending
Aggressive velocity weighting, FBA-only stock, critical items
Replenishment planning for Electronics product family
